fields: as a table: cols [your request, first response, what follows] (the two value labels head the lane zones), rows [request, first response, what follows], intro, nav. Cells may be {t, link, intent}.
best_for: ResponseLanes draws a table of response times by request as lanes on one clock: each request runs from where you call or send through its first response into what follows, every clause a stop with its time beneath, and the severities set as a calm scale of huge light numerals.

block.intro: Times apply on a service plan; without one, a call-out with the next available technician.
rows: Severity 1: production stopped or water out of specification
Answered within [severity 1 phone answer time, minutes]; remote diagnosis within [remote response time, hours]
On site within [severity 1 on-site response time, hours], inside [service coverage area]
Severity 2: alarm, reduced capacity or adverse trend
Reply within [severity 2 reply time, hours]
Visit within [severity 2 visit time]
Severity 3: no effect on water quality or supply
Reply within [severity 3 reply time, working days]
Fixed at the next or a booked visit
Severity 4: maintenance or calibration
Date within [maintenance booking reply time, working days]
Signed report; calibration certificates to USP <645> and <643>
Requalification after a change
Reply within [requalification support reply time, working days]
